name: Schnorr Signatures for secp256k1
summary: Replaced ECDSA with Schnorr signatures, enabling key and signature aggregation (multiple signatures can be combined into one). Also supports batch verification for faster signature checking.
summaryZh: 用 Schnorr 签名替代 ECDSA，支持密钥和签名聚合（多个签名可合并为一个）。同时支持批量验证以加快签名检查速度。
